query:
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
               u.balance_micro,
               COALESCE(e.sum_delta, 0)::bigint AS "events_sum!"
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT user_id, SUM(delta_micro) AS sum_delta
            FROM billing_events
            GROUP BY user_id
        ) e ON e.user_id = u.id
        WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY u.id
        LIMIT $1
